concave footprint measures actual polygon area rather than its bounding rectangle
concave footprint notch is genuinely empty
reversed polygon winding preserves the positive solid
rotated column uses its centre section and Base/Top Levels
beam is centred about its XY axis and extends below its top datum
one slab join creates one native transaction and preserves the beam identity

join Undo heals the beam and removes the reference
join Redo restores shape references and revision
slab priority cuts a rotated column top without splitting it
structural rows distinguish gross join deduction and actual net volume

a referenced Level cannot be deleted
slab change that fully cuts a beam rolls back

all rejected dependency edits preserve solids and authored values
invalid slab proposal after Undo is rejected before changing history
rejected slab cut preserves the existing native Redo branch
preserved Slab Redo still applies its valid thickness and member cuts
join that splits a column into disconnected solids is rejected
failed split join leaves no half-applied reference or solid
rejected split join preserves the existing native Redo branch
moving a referenced slab away preserves join intent with zero deduction
Unjoin heals a member without altering the cutter or other joined members
Unjoin Undo restores the column cut
invalid member operations preserve the entire model
joined beam section that would be fully removed is rejected before history changes
rejected joined Beam section preserves the native Redo branch
preserved Beam Redo still applies its valid section
joined column height that creates a disconnected cap is rejected before history changes
rejected joined Column proposal preserves the native Redo branch
preserved Column Redo still applies its valid rotation
Door and Window jointly cut their host wall
window opening is empty through the native wall and its frame centre
window has a real lower frame bar in contrast to the existing three-bar door
window row carries source host and actual cut/frame quantities
window overlapping an existing door is rejected
door overlapping an existing window is rejected
window exceeding host height is rejected
failed mixed openings preserve host and both frames
rejected mixed opening proposals preserve the native Redo branch
preserved Window Redo still applies its valid opening relocation
window rehost heals the old wall and cuts the rotated destination
rehost Undo restores original identity host and both wall solids
deleting a window heals its host while preserving the door
window deletion Undo restores persistent identity and opening
expanded snapshot is read-only for authored content and native history

direct native thickness edit propagates to joined members

same-volume displaced Slab is rejected by spatial export validation

two-storey fixture has every authored category with no derived duplicate rows
category totals follow the declared per-element join rules
expanded export writes six CSV categories plus one completion metadata file
CSV and IFC exports preserve native authored state and Undo history

columns CSV identities and revision match the model
beams CSV identities and revision match the model
windows CSV identities and revision match the model

written IFC passes expanded schema placement relationship and solid validation
